title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 025
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute rewind and back variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Circular rewind arrow outline with the number five centered inside the ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rewind timer marked with the number five.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for other rewind counts when the centered number five is the key difference.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the same circular rewind arrow family with a bold number five inside.

items.depicts_observation: Circular rewind arrow outline with the number ten centered inside the ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rewind timer marked with the number ten.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the other rewind counts when the centered number ten must remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot matches the rewind ring family but changes the inner number to ten.

items.depicts_observation: Circular rewind arrow outline with the number fifteen centered inside the ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the rewind timer variant marked with fifteen.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the five ten or thirty variants when the number fifteen matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the rewind ring and swaps the inner label to fifteen.

items.depicts_observation: Circular rewind arrow outline with the number thirty centered inside the ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the largest rewind timer in this circular ring family.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the lower rewind counts when the number thirty must stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the same rewind ring family with the bold number thirty at center.

items.depicts_observation: Left hooked return arrow with a straight lower line and rounded outer bend
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a plain back or return arrow rather than a numbered media rewind icon.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for circular rewind timers when the icon should stay as one simple return arrow.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a plain hooked back arrow without a circle or countdown number.
